purpose: attribute the reproducible mass-aware +45 mm sentinel contact branch without tuning on its outcome
required_signals: all active robot contact entity/geom/link identities
contact positions, normals, penetration, force_a and force_b
finger actual internal force and controller force
bilateral parcel support and 35 N crossing
required_summary: per-finger maximum absolute actual and control force
raw artifact byte count and SHA-256

decision_tree.adapter_parcel_contact_spike: freeze a contact-discretization, edge-geometry, or compliance investigation
decision_tree.robot_environment_or_self_spike: add swept loaded-path clearance to the planner
decision_tree.same_contact_identity_with_finger_force_: freeze a bounded trajectory-modulation or impedance candidate
decision_tree.unattributed: retain a simulator contact-sensitivity benchmark and stop expansion
